numerical_fixtures.scope: Deterministic grid spans sigma0..1 and logit(s)-30..30; this does not certify every possible input or a future implementation.
numerical_fixtures.proposed_numerical_contract: Fix the quadrature rule; stabilize in log space; use xlogy/log1p equivalents at boundaries; allow -inf zero weights only when some finite weight exists; report unusable weights instead of uniform fallback.

stream_fixtures.qualification: Finite enumeration found no duplicate states in this installed runtime; SeedSequence does not mathematically guarantee collision-free/nonoverlapping streams. Pin NumPy/BitGenerator and bind ordering plus k-then-r draw convention.

source_and_feasibility.truth_source_contract: Extract six-coordinate theta from original v1 selected[population].params, bind source row hashes and IDs. A compact observed-mode rerun is not a source of true theta; it stores params={}.
source_and_feasibility.current_availability_limit: Source schema verified locally; no new read of all remote original row payloads in this review.
source_and_feasibility.membership_contract: Use k=K (not truncated K+1), identical bank/shard row order, mask/MAD and pinned runtime; bind actual draw IDs. A matching rounded Kth distance does not certify membership at ties.
source_and_feasibility.resource_limit: Thirty minutes is a planning estimate, not a measured bound; preserve one-pass/per-population processing and record elapsed time/peak memory. Stage0 measures support diagnostics only, with no fitted classification or Stage1 permission.
source_and_feasibility.ESS100_interpretation: Declared concentration flag for exploratory diagnostics; not a demonstrated validity threshold. Report continuous ESS/max-weight share and any-of-nine fractions by scenario and n for both noisy and ideal weights.
